description: Source code for WatsonXApi class implementing BaseLlmApi interface, handling API interactions with IBM WatsonX for chat and completion functionalities.

classes.name: WatsonXApi
classes.description: Class implementing API interactions with IBM WatsonX, including token management, chat completion, and streaming.

methods.name: getBearerToken
methods.description: Fetches and returns a bearer token for API authentication, handling both SaaS and software deployment scenarios.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs API endpoint URL based on deployment and API version.

methods.name: _convertBody
methods.description: Converts OpenAI-style request body into WatsonX API payload format.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers including authorization token for API requests.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Performs a non-streaming chat completion request, aggregating streamed chunks into a full response.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion responses from WatsonX API using Server-Sent Events.

methods.name: completionStream
methods.description: Streams text completion responses, parsing streamed data into structured output.
